short_name.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Danish School of Media and Journalism (DMJX)/Fact sheet DMJX.pdf#page=1

min_standing_note.value: Programmes target specific bachelor year levels (e.g., 2nd, 3rd, or 4th year depending on chosen English semester track).
min_standing_note.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Danish School of Media and Journalism (DMJX)/DMJX international programs.pdf#page=4

eligible_auc_schools.notes: Excel Col H specifies 'Journalism' major rather than a specific AUC school code.

eligible_majors.notes: Excel scope specifies 'Journalism'; English exchange tracks span Journalism, Photojournalism, Corporate Communication, TV/Media Production, and Interactive Design.

excluded_majors.notes: No free-choice multi-department course picking: exchange students enroll in fixed 30-ECTS international semester programmes (Fact Sheet p.2; https://www.dmjx.dk/international/studies-english).

min_gpa_host.notes: No numeric minimum GPA published; portfolio and year-level prerequisites apply to specific programmes (DMJX international programs.pdf).

instruction_languages.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Danish School of Media and Journalism (DMJX)/Fact sheet DMJX.pdf#page=2
instruction_languages.notes: International semester programmes are taught completely in English.

english_course_availability.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Danish School of Media and Journalism (DMJX)/Fact sheet DMJX.pdf#page=2
english_course_availability.notes: Fixed 30-ECTS international exchange programmes taught in English.

english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.value: Fact Sheet lists IELTS >=6.5, Cambridge C1, or 'at least 80 in the computer based Toefl test' (likely referring to Internet-based TOEFL 80). Test waived if applicant studied >=1 year in an English-language environment (applicable to AUC).
english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Danish School of Media and Journalism (DMJX)/Fact sheet DMJX.pdf#page=2

host_language_requirement.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Danish School of Media and Journalism (DMJX)/Fact sheet DMJX.pdf#page=2

fall_term_dates.value: Fall semester: Week 34 - Week 52/Week 3 (late August to December/mid-January including exams).
fall_term_dates.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Danish School of Media and Journalism (DMJX)/Fact sheet DMJX.pdf#page=2

spring_term_dates.value: Spring semester: Week 4 - Week 25 (late January to late June including exams).
spring_term_dates.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Danish School of Media and Journalism (DMJX)/Fact sheet DMJX.pdf#page=2

seat_quota.notes: Fact sheet/website mentions welcoming ~60 exchange students across partners per semester total, not an AUC-specific quota.

tuition_model.notes: Partner-nominated exchange students are exempt from DMJX tuition fees.

est_monthly_living_local.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Danish School of Media and Journalism (DMJX)/Fact sheet DMJX.pdf#page=3
est_monthly_living_local.notes: Derived monthly cost from Fact Sheet p.3 (dated 2025-01-21) separate semester rows: Living costs for a semester 3,500 EUR + Housing costs 2,400 EUR = 5,900 EUR total per 5-month semester (~1,180 EUR/month; excludes housing 700 EUR/month alone).

living_cost_usd_est.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Danish School of Media and Journalism (DMJX)/Fact sheet DMJX.pdf#page=3
living_cost_usd_est.notes: 5-month estimate derived from monthly EUR range 1,180/month. FX rate 1 EUR = 1.1052 USD from ECB Euro reference exchange rates (2026-11-13, retrieved 2026-11-15 at https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/policy_and_exchange_rates/euro_reference_exchange_rates/html/index.en.html); 5-month USD est = 1,180.0 EUR * 5 * 1.1052 = 6,520.68 USD.

mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.value: Tuition exempt for partner nominees; students must arrange health/travel insurance at their own expense.
mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Danish School of Media and Journalism (DMJX)/Fact sheet DMJX.pdf#page=3

housing_availability.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Danish School of Media and Journalism (DMJX)/Fact sheet DMJX.pdf#page=2
housing_availability.notes: Housing partly offered: Campus Copenhagen provides rooms located near campus; most Campus Aarhus students must find student housing independently using links provided by DMJX.

housing_notes.value: Estimated semester housing cost 2,400 EUR (~480 EUR/month over 5 months).
housing_notes.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Danish School of Media and Journalism (DMJX)/Fact sheet DMJX.pdf#page=3

host_grants_or_stipends.notes: Fact sheet p.3 references Erasmus+ grants only for European/Erasmus+ partners; no institutional stipend for bilateral non-EU partners.

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: Non-EU/EEA students must obtain a Danish student residence permit prior to arrival; visa instructions are sent upon admission (Fact Sheet p.3 & https://www.dmjx.dk/international/coming-denmark).

credit_system_and_load.value: ECTS credit system; fixed full-time workload of 30 ECTS per semester (single packaged programme with no open elective swapping).
credit_system_and_load.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Danish School of Media and Journalism (DMJX)/Fact sheet DMJX.pdf#page=2

course_restrictions_note.value: Students enroll in one fixed 30-ECTS programme (Aarhus or Copenhagen campus depending on track); Photojournalism / TV & Media Production / Interactive Design require portfolios and prior experience.
course_restrictions_note.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Danish School of Media and Journalism (DMJX)/Fact sheet DMJX.pdf#page=2

value: English proficiency proof (IELTS 6.5 / Cambridge C1 / TOEFL 80; waived if >=1 yr English-language study per Fact Sheet p.2)
required_application_docs.notes: Nominations/applications on Fact Sheet p.1; English & portfolio rules on Fact Sheet p.2 & dmjx.dk/international/studies-english.

academic_style.value: Practice-oriented journalism/media workshop and studio project programmes mixing international and Danish students across Aarhus and Copenhagen campuses.
academic_style.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Danish School of Media and Journalism (DMJX)/DMJX international programs.pdf#page=3

city_tier.notes: Two campuses in Aarhus and Copenhagen; Excel lists Copenhagen, Fact Sheet p.1 lists both.

campus_type.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Danish School of Media and Journalism (DMJX)/DMJX international programs.pdf#page=3
campus_type.notes: Explicitly operates Two Campuses: Campus Aarhus (Helsingforsgade 6A-D, Aarhus N) and Campus Copenhagen (Amagerfælledvej 190, København S); also Fact Sheet p.1.

daily_life_english_friendliness.notes: Not explicitly rated on dmjx.dk or fact sheet.

international_support_services.value: International Office coordinators for Aarhus and Copenhagen campuses, housing application links/guidance, and Coming to Denmark survival info.
international_support_services.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Danish School of Media and Journalism (DMJX)/Fact sheet DMJX.pdf#page=1

nomination_deadlines.value: Fall semester: Nomination Mar 15 (via email), Application Apr 1. Spring semester: Nomination Sep 15, Application Oct 1.
nomination_deadlines.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Danish School of Media and Journalism (DMJX)/Fact sheet DMJX.pdf#page=1
